mainEntity.name: What services does AI Nexus × Neon AI Studio offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI video ads and AI video production, video editing and animation, website and ecommerce development, mobile app development, logo, branding and graphic design, SEO and digital marketing, social media marketing, AI chatbots and automation, and web hosting with HTTPS security. The full list is at https://neonaistudio.in/services.html.

mainEntity.name: Which countries do you work with?

acceptedAnswer.text: We work with clients worldwide, fully remotely. Key markets include India, Dubai and the UAE, Kuwait, Luxembourg, Japan, the USA, the UK, Canada, Australia, Germany, Singapore, Ireland, New Zealand and South Africa.

mainEntity.name: How do I order a service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Message us on WhatsApp at +91 9226520552 (or email moreshwar1234bhonde@gmail.com) with what you need. We confirm the brief, price and timeline, then start work. Every plan on the website has a "Get Plan" button that opens WhatsApp with the plan pre-filled.
Yes. Everything is delivered online — files, links and websites are shared over WhatsApp, email or cloud links, with English-first communication and time-zone-friendly hand-offs.

mainEntity.name: How much does an AI video cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The STANDARD plan is 599 INR per video (up to 30/32 seconds) and the PREMIUM plan is 1019 INR per video (up to 60/65 seconds). Longer films and bulk packs are quoted on WhatsApp.

mainEntity.name: What are your web hosting and security prices?

acceptedAnswer.text: Diamond Plan Unlimited hosting is 199 INR per month on a 48-month term (renews at 649 INR/month). Gold Premium hosting is 139 INR per month on a 24-month term (renews at 449 INR/month). The Secured System (HTTPS/SSL set-up) is 2999 INR.
Short videos are typically delivered in 24–48 hours. Websites, apps and branding projects get a timeline when the brief is confirmed.

mainEntity.name: Can you build websites and apps for international businesses?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We build responsive websites, ecommerce stores (Shopify, WordPress, WooCommerce) and Android/iOS apps for businesses in any country, and can add SEO, hosting and HTTPS.
